description: Binary, unweighted rubric. Every criterion is PASS/FAIL and every one is mandatory: the rubric passes only if all pass. Only include criteria worth rejecting a submission over. State the approach, never a specific identifier.

criteria.criterion: No test, snapshot, or test-harness file was modified; the change touches only product source code
The change addresses the underlying behavior rather than special-casing or hard-coding whatever the test happens to assert
REPLACE ME with a criterion about this bug and fix, phrased so a different but correct fix still passes
